newsitem.title: USA: United Tech stock sharply higher on earnings.
newsitem.headline: United Tech stock sharply higher on earnings.

text.p: Shares in industrial-technology stock United Technologies Corp were sharply higher late Thursday morning, three hours after the company released its earnings which came in above most analysts' estimates.
A United Technologies spokesman had no comment on the movement.
At 1110 EST, the stock was up 4 to 70-3/4, off its morning high of 71-3/8. Turnover was 537,400 shares, compared with average daily volume for the issue of about 551,000 shares.
United Technologies said earlier on Thursday that fourth quarter revenues rose in all its business segments except that of Flight Systems.
"The operating performance of the company was terrific across all lines of business," said Joe Campbell, aerospace analyst at Lehman Brothers.
"The whole company did well," he said.
